verdict.rationale: Perplexity publishes a documented public API (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, search, embeddings) with an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt index, plus an official CLI and MCP server for agentic use, giving AI-native users clear programmatic access. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of API reliability and rate limits, and more detail on auth/versioning stability beyond docs claims.
